name: tree_fern
description: Carboniferous tree fern (Psaronius-type): straight shaggy brown trunk (#5a4a30) flaring into a matted root mantle at the base, diamond leaf-base scars up top, crowned by long arching finely divided fronds (#4f8a3a, darker #3a6a2a behind) that droop out to the sides. No branches (unlike scale_tree). Anchor = trunk base centre (0,0). ~440x620 (x -220..220, y -620..0).
